description: This Java source file configures OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation for a Spring Boot application. It defines beans for API metadata, server URL configuration, and a forwarded headers filter to support proxy environments.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class providing OpenAPI documentation and proxy support for the Spring Boot application.

methods.name: forwardedHeaderFilter
methods.description: Registers a filter to handle X-Forwarded-* headers, enabling correct URL generation behind proxies.

methods.name: applicationOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and configures the OpenAPI specification object with title, version, description, and server URL based on context path.

methods.name: groupedOpenApi
methods.description: Defines a group for the API endpoints to be included in the Swagger UI, defaulting to all paths.
